ITEM 1 | Four breaded pieces, golden-tan crust with visible granular, sandy-textured coating, dry matte surface with slight sheen; roughly 3-4 cm pieces, irregular rounded shapes, with white creamy filling visible at one cut edge; sits on the left-center of the plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Crumbled white/cream filling showing through a broken crust edge, soft and slightly flaky, pale off-white color; sits between breaded pieces | 10
ITEM 3 | Red pepper pieces, bright red diced strips, glossy and moist, partly tucked under and beside the breaded pieces | 12
ITEM 4 | Green herb leaf, dark green, flat and glossy, small leaf about 3 cm long, lying on the breaded pieces | 3
ITEM 5 | Mixed salad greens: curly frisée and darker spinach-like leaves, bright green to pale yellow-green, crisp and ruffled, slightly moist, arranged on the right side of the plate | 45
ITEM 6 | Scattered golden-brown toasted nuts or seeds, small granular pieces, dry matte, mixed among the greens | 4
ITEM 7 | Dark blue-black olive or berry, small smooth round piece, glossy skin, sits among the greens on the right | 3
ITEM 8 | Small pinkish-red tomato piece, moist and glossy, partly under greens at lower right | 8
ITEM 9 | Light brown sauce or dressing residue, thin smeared streaks and crumbs of breading on plate surface, matte and slightly glossy, near the top center of the plate | 5
